mapper.insert: INSERT INTO odin_task_instance_exec ( task_guid, instance_guid, task_name, process_guid, instance_name, processor_queue, affinity_processor, designated_processor, executed_processor, image_path, cluster_name, exec_state, sequence_cnt, current_retry_number, retry_times, start_time, run_time, finish_time ) VALUES ( #{taskGuid}, #{instanceGuid}, #{taskName}, #{processGuid}, #{instanceName}, #{processorQueue}, #{affinityProcessor}, #{designatedProcessor}, #{executedProcessor}, #{imagePath}, #{clusterName}, #{execState}, #{sequenceCnt}, #{currentRetryNumber}, #{retryTimes}, #{startTime}, #{runTime}, #{finishTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_guid, instance_guid, task_name, process_guid, instance_name, processor_queue, affinity_processor, designated_processor, executed_processor, image_path, cluster_name, exec_state, sequence_cnt, current_retry_number, retry_times, start_time, run_time, finish_time FROM odin_task_instance_exec WHERE instance_guid = #{instanceGuid} ORDER BY sequence_cnt DESC, current_retry_number DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, task_guid, instance_guid, task_name, process_guid, instance_name, processor_queue, affinity_processor, designated_processor, executed_processor, image_path, cluster_name, exec_state, sequence_cnt, current_retry_number, retry_times, start_time, run_time, finish_time FROM odin_task_instance_exec WHERE instance_guid = #{instanceGuid} ORDER BY sequence_cnt DESC, current_retry_number DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, task_guid, instance_guid, task_name, process_guid, instance_name, processor_queue, affinity_processor, designated_processor, executed_processor, image_path, cluster_name, exec_state, sequence_cnt, current_retry_number, retry_times, start_time, run_time, finish_time FROM odin_task_instance_exec WHERE instance_guid = #{instanceGuid} AND sequence_cnt = #{sequenceCnt} AND current_retry_number = #{currentRetryNumber} LIMIT 1

SELECT exec.id, exec.task_guid, exec.instance_guid, exec.task_name, exec.process_guid, exec.instance_name, exec.processor_queue, exec.affinity_processor, exec.designated_processor, exec.executed_processor, exec.image_path, exec.cluster_name, exec.exec_state, exec.sequence_cnt, exec.current_retry_number, exec.retry_times, exec.start_time, exec.run_time, exec.finish_time FROM odin_task_instance_exec exec LEFT JOIN odin_task_ins_exec_audit audit ON audit.instance_guid = exec.instance_guid AND audit.sequence_cnt = exec.sequence_cnt AND audit.current_retry_number = exec.current_retry_number AND audit.audit_type = 'Logger' WHERE exec.exec_state IN ('Success', 'Fail', 'Killed') AND audit.id IS NULL ORDER BY exec.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT MIN( `id` ) AS min_id, MAX( `id` ) AS max_id FROM odin_task_instance_exec WHERE exec_state = 'Running'

SELECT exec.id AS exec_id, exec.task_guid, exec.instance_guid AS instance_guid, exec.task_name, exec.instance_name, exec.process_guid, exec.executed_processor, exec.exec_state, exec.sequence_cnt, exec.current_retry_number, exec.start_time AS exec_start_time, exec.run_time AS exec_run_time, exec.update_time AS exec_update_time, ins.run_status AS instance_status, ins.sequence_cnt AS instance_sequence_cnt, ins.retry_cnt AS instance_retry_cnt, ins.dry_run, ins.update_time AS instance_update_time FROM odin_task_instance_exec exec JOIN hydra_task_instances ins ON ins.guid = exec.instance_guid WHERE exec.id >= #{idMin} AND exec.id <= #{idMax} AND exec.exec_state = 'Running' AND COALESCE( ins.dry_run, 0 ) = 0 ORDER BY exec.id ASC

WHERE instance_guid = #{instanceGuid}

UPDATE odin_task_instance_exec
exec_state = #{execState},

process_guid = #{processGuid},
WHERE instance_guid = #{instanceGuid} AND sequence_cnt = #{sequenceCnt} AND current_retry_number = #{currentRetryNumber}
